Purge valve or leak detection module faulty

P00FF.d: P00FF is an information code in the engine control module: the body control module has detected an emissions-relevant fault of its own and asks over the data bus for the check engine light. The engine module stores P00FF so that a generic OBD scanner can see why the MIL is on; the actual fault is stored in the body control module as B or U codes and must be read there.
s: Check engine light on without an engine fault
Other messages depending on the body module fault
c: Emissions-relevant fault in the body control module or its sensors/actuators (own B/U codes)
Software or calibration fault in the body control module
Communication fault on the data bus
